why do the monsoon winds change direction twice a year

Land and sea heat at different speeds. In summer India's land bakes far hotter than the Indian Ocean, hot air rises, and moist sea air rushes in behind it: that is the rain-bringing south-west monsoon. In winter the land cools faster, the flow reverses, and the wind blows out from the land instead. 🌬️ [QUIZ]In the summer monsoon, which way does the wind blow?[/QUIZ] [CHIPS]Sea to land|Land to sea[/CHIPS]

how do origami designers invent brand new models

Not by guessing, but by drawing the crease pattern first 📐. how does cutting down a forest change the rainfall

why does a pressure cooker cook dal faster than an open pot
